title: Fibonacci
description: Build the first twelve Fibonacci numbers with a pair of accumulators. Change the final count, or call フィボナッチ with a nonnegative index.

title: FizzBuzz
description: The familiar counting exercise, from 1 to 30. A pure function chooses each word; a procedure prints the sequence. Keep the upper bound at least 1.

title: Prime numbers
description: Find primes between 2 and 50 by trial division. 素数か accepts nonnegative integers. Keep the final upper bound at least 2; small ranges work best.

title: Greatest common divisor
description: Euclid’s algorithm in a handful of lines. Try your own pair of nonnegative integers in the final calls.

title: Collatz sequence
description: Start at 7, halve even numbers, and triple odd numbers then add one. Try another small positive starting number. Long sequences may reach the call or time limit.

title: Multiplication table
description: The 9x9 table (九九). One recursion walks the columns of a row and builds its text; another walks the rows. Change the final range to print fewer or more rows.

title: Exponentiation by squaring
description: Raise a base to a power with one recursive call per bit of the exponent, rather than one per unit. べき乗 expects a nonnegative exponent.

title: Binary representation
description: Convert a nonnegative integer to binary by concatenating the quotient's digits ahead of the current remainder. Try another number in the final calls.

title: Palindromic numbers
description: Reverse a number's digits with an accumulator and compare it with the original. Nonnegative integers only; trailing zeros disappear when reversed, as 90 shows.

title: Insertion sort
description: Sort a list from the shared library by inserting each element into a sorted tail. 未満 compares nonnegative integers through floor division, since the builtins provide equality only.

title: Hello, world
description: Your first particle call. Change the text inside the Japanese quotation marks and run it again.

title: Arithmetic
description: Try arithmetic with explicit argument roles. Reorder the arguments while keeping their particles attached.

title: Factorial
description: A pure recursive function computes 6 factorial. Try another small nonnegative number.

title: An interactive greeting
description: Read one line from the input box, bind it, and greet that person. Edit the supplied input below the editor.

title: Strings & escapes
description: Explore Japanese quotation marks, escaped characters, and string operations.

title: Lexical scope
description: Immutable bindings belong to their blocks. An inner scope may shadow an outer name.

title: Map & fold
description: Import the bundled list library, transform a generic list, and combine its elements.

title: Optional values
description: Use the bundled option library to express presence and absence explicitly.

title: Capturing closures
description: Create independent increment functions, then use one to map a list. Each closure remembers its own increment.

title: A greeting that remembers
description: Read a name once and capture it in a procedure that can greet twice. Try changing the input.

title: Nested patterns
description: Classify optional lists with ordered patterns and keep a matched value inside a closure.

title: Compact notation
description: Let particles touch integers and closing delimiters. Identifier words still keep explicit boundaries.

title: Names & particle choices
description: Declare alternate function spellings and accepted particles explicitly. Their types and effects stay checked.
